glosses: to shoot, to fire a projectile weapon [with z (+ genitive) ‘a projectile weapon’]
to shoot (to kill wild game with a projectile weapon)
to shoot (to give off a loud sound similar to that of a gun)
to shoot (to send a ball towards a goal with a hit)
to shoot, to score (to gain a point by shooting)
to shoot up (to suddenly go upward)
to shoot up (to grow taller or larger rapidly)
to shoot (to quickly drink a small portion of alcohol)
to shoot off at the mouth
used as a light verb, particularly to replace zrobić (“to do, to make”)

examples.text: Próbowała kluczyć niezdarnie. Żołnierz strzelił i Rachela zatrzymała się

glosses: Tirer à l’arc ou une arme à feu.
